verdict.rationale: Dropbox's docs show shared folders that can be shared with anyone, including people without an account. They also show viewer-only access, customizable sharing links, and password-protected files, which covers the organized-folder and view-only parts of a lightweight data room. The pack has no evidence of download controls or of visibility into who accessed or viewed documents, so the diligence-specific half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: download disabling/controls on links, access visibility or view analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration of data-room use.
